item.text: I’ll trace project creation, archiving, restoration, and status updates, then fix the checks and counters involved.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'project\\.(created|archived|restored)|projects:|countProjects|assertNotArchived|createIssue' src/server src/lib | head -120; cat src/lib/slug.ts; cat src/server/services/issue-service.ts | head -155; rg -n 'project' src/server/events src/server/jobs"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'project\\.(created|archived|restored)|projects:|countProjects|assertNotArchived|createIssue' src/server src/lib | head -120; cat src/lib/slug.ts; cat src/server/services/issue-service.ts | head -155; rg -n 'project' src/server/events src/server/jobs"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/server/services/usage-service.ts src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts; cat src/actions/projects/create-project.ts; cat package.json; rg -n 'project.restored|projectsUsed|projects_used' src"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/server/services/usage-service.ts src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts; cat src/actions/projects/create-project.ts; cat package.json; rg -n 'project.restored|projectsUsed|projects_used' src"

item.text: The quota count includes archived projects, status updates are discarded, and restores lack both a quota check and a usage-counter update. I’ll fix those paths and reserve keys and addresses across archived projects too.
